name: Shiga Masamune
source:
Calm and collected, Masamune is number one in his class academically, while also working part-time at Gate Keepers. He lives without the use of his legs, so during battle he supports his friends via a remote link. He enjoys working with computers and playing wheelchair tennis.

[From [url=http://www.nisamerica.com/games/tokyotwilightghosthunters/characters/]official website[/url]]
